title: What a Block Explorer Is
summary: A block explorer is a website that lets anyone look up the public data on a blockchain — transactions, addresses, blocks and balances.
blocks: A block explorer is a website that lets anyone look up the public data on a blockchain — transactions, addresses, blocks and balances.
Because blockchains are public, an explorer is simply a readable window into records that already exist for everyone to see.
It is a practical tool: you can confirm a payment, inspect an address's history, or verify a transaction hash without trusting anyone's word for it.
